## Motivation

The MI355X DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 PD cookbook still documents c1 with two request slots and decode graph sizes 1–2. Its Docker commands also select an older image despite enabling mxscale GEMM and power-of-two routing settings.

This completes the cookbook follow-up to #44454 identified in [InferenceX #4186](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4186#issuecomment-6279021019). Source configuration: [recipe at `6ad6674d9de2`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/6ad6674d9de25c0abfc3ed511a580c147cfd47df/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/multi_node/srt-slurm-recipes/dsv4/sglang/mi355x-fp4/agentx/disagg-umbp-dspark.yaml).

## Modifications

- Document eight request slots on both c1 workers and decode graph sizes 1–8, while keeping client concurrency at one. Explain the exception to the strategy presets' `2 × concurrency` sizing rule.
- Select `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261019` for both Pro and Pro Official FP4 PD prefill, decode and router Docker commands, and update the matching example. Both variants share one image; single-node images remain unchanged.
- Remove submission/PR-following descriptions from the PD documentation and config comments; keep provenance in this PR description.

This touches §3.7 and its deployment guidance/config resolver. #45268 addresses the separate single-node §3.6 recipe.

## Validation

- `git diff --check` and pre-commit on both changed files: passed.
- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`: passed.
- `node --test docs/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs`: 38/38 passed.
- Evaluated all 18 combinations of Pro/Pro Official × three strategies × three PD roles: both variants select the new image, and every other resolved field matches the base revision.
- Compared c1 admission limits, decode graph sizes and TP sizing with the pinned source recipe: passed.
- `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` (CI-pinned mint 4.2.559): passed.
- `mint validate`: blocked by the pre-existing extra `},` at `docs/src/snippets/configs/popular-models.jsx:100`, which prevents its imports in the two landing pages. The unchanged file at the base revision also fails JavaScript parsing.
- Verified the public Docker Hub tag is active, digest `sha256:8cb29fc407c2e46bdb1866c5edb91f109ac1acbbcb6905089beaa6c79b0813a2`.

## Accuracy Tests

No new GPU runs; documentation and command-generation image selection only. The original Pro EAGLE/MTP variant has not been revalidated on the newer image; the linked run covers Pro Official DSpark. Existing source performance/eval evidence: [InferenceX run 39244119974](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39244119974).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not rerun. No runtime implementation changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Validate affected command generation and run existing documentation tests.
- [x] Update documentation.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

This holds for DSpark and EAGLE/MTP alike. The table above follows it: 32 serves a concurrency of 16, 96 serves 48, and 512 serves the high-throughput concurrency of 256.  The decode role's `--cuda-graph-bs-decode` then has to cover `N*2 / attn_dp_size`, the per-rank batch. The strategy presets apply both rules: decode graphs cover 1–32, 1–96, and 1–64, respectively.

 The panel keeps its c16 / c48 / c256 strategy presets. Apply the following overrides to the **Multi-Nodes** commands to reproduce the optimized recipe's endpoints. Here `cN` means a target concurrency of N.

Replace decode's graph list with `--cuda-graph-bs-decode 1 2`. Keep DSpark block size 6 (7 draft tokens), `MORI_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_DECODE=448`, and both kernel switches on both roles.
